international_letter.description: standard international letter, up to 20 g, to Canada (International Letter, first weight band up to 50 g)
international_letter.price_text: 44 SEK (up to 50 g, stamp or postnord.se), prices valid from January 1, 2026, exempt from VAT
international_letter.notes: Single international rate table, not split by destination zone. Mark the letter with the 'Prioritaire' label or write 'Prioritaire' on the left side of the stamp. Other bands: 100 g 66 SEK, 250 g 110 SEK (92 via postnord.se), 500 g 140 SEK (115), 1,000 g 200 SEK (180), 2,000 g 240 SEK (220).

notes_for_senders.fact: PostNord: write the sender's name and address on the letter, otherwise it cannot be sent to the receiving country.
